facts.fact: The article says Maroc Digital 2030 was launched in September 2024, naming no adopting act or body.
The article gives Maroc Digital 2030 targets of 240,000 digital jobs and 3,000 start-ups by 2030, with no cost stated; no date is given for the statement, so the published date is used.

On 17 July 2026 the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform signed a memorandum with Capgemini Maroc on AI skills in administrations, universities and research centres, presented as part of implementing Maroc Digital 2030.
